zh: 交换整串中的两种字母，相当于对字母表做一个置换；无论做多少次，“哪些位置上的字符相等”这个模式都不会改变。
所以能变成目标，当且仅当原串到目标串存在一个双向一致的字母对应：同一个原字母总对应同一个目标字母，同一个目标字母也只来自同一个原字母。这样的对应可以补全成 26 个字母的置换，而任意置换都能拆成若干次交换。
对每一对字符串，开两个长度 26 的数组 forward、back 并置为未定义；逐位置取 x=a[i]、y=b[i]，若 forward[x] 已定义且不等于 y，或 back[y] 已定义且不等于 x，则输出 0；否则记录 forward[x]=y、back[y]=x。全部位置都一致则输出 1。
en: Swapping two letters throughout the string applies a permutation to the alphabet; however many times you do it, the pattern of which positions hold equal characters never changes.

So the target is reachable exactly when there is a letter correspondence that is consistent in both directions: the same source letter always maps to the same target letter, and each target letter comes from only one source letter. Such a correspondence extends to a permutation of all 26 letters, and any permutation decomposes into swaps.

For each pair of strings use two arrays forward and back of size 26, initially undefined; for each position take x = a[i], y = b[i], and if forward[x] is defined and differs from y, or back[y] is defined and differs from x, output 0; otherwise record forward[x] = y and back[y] = x. If every position is consistent output 1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Build, position by position, the mapping from source characters to target characters and the reverse mapping; a conflict in either direction makes it impossible, otherwise it is feasible.

## Correctness

Global letter swaps compose into a permutation of the alphabet, which always preserves whether the characters at any two positions are equal. A mapping that is consistent in both directions is exactly this preservation of the equality pattern; it can be extended to a permutation of the whole 26-letter alphabet, and any permutation can be decomposed into pairwise swaps, so the condition is also sufficient.

## Complexity

Time O(total characters), space O(total input size), with O(26) auxiliary mapping per pair.
